scope: Game-design questions and user answers only. Original options preserved when available. Dates in file names are America/Los_Angeles; provenance timestamps are UTC.
completeness: Recovered entries only; missing answers are explicitly marked. This is not a complete export of every chat or every historical interview.

entries.question: ❓ Q1 — Entrance control: should players walk up the stairs and through the gate themselves, or watch a short automatic entrance? ➡️ I recommend player-controlled movement with the squad.
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q2 — Starting weapons: should the arsenal replace the opening gun-selection screen? ➡️ I recommend choosing one free primary and one free secondary at the arsenal; later purchases and upgrades still cost shards.
options: Choose both free starting guns at the arsenal (recommended)
Choose guns in the menu, then collect them at the arsenal
entries.answer: Choose both free starting guns at the arsenal (recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q3 — Entrance frequency: where should this arrival happen? ➡️ I recommend the full staircase entrance at the start of a run, with shorter entrances between later arenas.
options: Full entrance at run start; shorter later arrivals (recommended)
First arena only; other arrivals stay as they are
entries.answer: Full entrance at run start; shorter later arrivals (recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q4 — Visual direction: how should the colosseum entrance look? ➡️ I recommend a massive industrial sci-fi gate, broad steps, worn metal and stone, and restrained arena lighting.
options: Mostly stone colosseum with sci-fi machinery
entries.answer: A mix of 1 and 2. Lets it follow the current mockup styles

entries.question: ❓ Q5 — Starting combat: should the squad explicitly ready up before the first encounter? ➡️ I recommend everyone equipped and ready before enemies can arrive; the existing 90-second regroup breaks would stay between encounters.
options: Host starts once everyone has weapons
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q6 — Arsenal location: should the squad collect its guns before passing through the main gate, or walk through the gate to reach the arsenal inside the arena? ➡️ I recommend an arsenal on the entrance landing: prepare together, ready up, then the gate opens.
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q7 — Perks: should players choose their two perks in the lobby, or at the arsenal with their weapons? ➡️ I recommend perks in the lobby so the entrance arsenal stays focused and easy to read.
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q8 — Preparation area: should it be a quiet, protected staging area or allow live-fire weapon testing? ➡️ I recommend protected staging for the first implementation, with no enemies before the squad starts.
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q9 — Free starter pool: should we preserve the current opening choices—Gale or Phasma for the primary, and Gale, Phasma or a wildcard for the secondary, without duplicates? ➡️ I recommend preserving that pool; Helix, Vector and Ion remain later arsenal purchases.

entries.question: ❓ Q10 — Team bonus: the current setup also has a shared passive-bonus vote after perks. ➡️ I recommend moving that vote into the lobby alongside perk selection, so there are no timed selection screens after loading.

entries.answer: Move the team-bonus vote into the lobby (recommended)

entries.question: ❓ Q11 — Grabbing guns: how should the entrance arsenal work? ➡️ I recommend visible weapon racks with a compact selection/inspection panel, with detailed stats tucked behind Details.
options: Weapon racks and a compact panel (recommended)
Use the full arsenal shop menu

entries.question: ❓ Q12 — Later arenas: should the squad keep its weapons, use a shorter entrance, and ready up before enemies arrive? ➡️ I recommend this, without collecting starter guns again.

entries.question: ❓ Q13 — Initial preparation time: should players have as long as they need to collect guns and ready up? ➡️ I recommend no forced countdown. Changing your loadout clears your ready status; the 90-second breaks still apply between encounters.

entries.question: ❓ Q14 — After everyone is equipped and ready, should the entrance gate open and enemies wait until the entire active squad has walked inside? ➡️ I recommend this: everyone enters together, the gate closes safely once clear, then the first encounter begins.
options: Wait until the whole squad enters (recommended)
Start combat when the first player enters
entries.answer: Wait until the whole squad enters (recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question:
Approve this entrance implementation?

• Choose two perks and the shared team bonus in the lobby; remove timed selection screens after loading.
• Walk with the squad up a stone-and-industrial sci-fi colosseum staircase matching our arena mockups.
• Use weapon racks and a compact panel at the protected arsenal before the gate. Details stay optional.
• Collect one free primary and one free secondary: preserve the current Gale/Phasma/wildcard starter eligibility, with no duplicates.
• Take as long as needed. Everyone must be equipped and ready; changing a loadout clears readiness.
• The gate opens when everyone is ready. Combat waits until the whole active squad enters, then the gate closes safely.
• Later arenas retain your gear, use shorter entrances and wait for team readiness; no repeat free starting guns.
• Keep the in-arena arsenal for paid known weapons, random rerolls and upgrades, including during combat. Purchases use shards.
• Keep 90-second regroup breaks with early team start between encounters.
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.
